test_points.mechanism: Send GET /api/items/1 to the isolated fixture and compare the HTTP status and complete JSON response, including the string type of id.
preconditions: The fixture endpoint is available to the future formal Runtime run.
Use the frozen fixture baseline only; do not infer production data or business semantics.
test_points.core_expected: GET /api/items/1 returns HTTP 200 and exactly {"id":"1","name":"Smoke item","status":"ready"}; id is a string.
must_not_change: No fixture business data is mutated by this read-only lookup.
Do not assert persistence or real-product semantics from this response.

test_points.mechanism: In the isolated fixture UI, click the Load item button and assert that the visible #result text exactly matches the baseline.
preconditions: The fixture page is available to the future formal Runtime run and exposes the Load item button.
Use the frozen fixture baseline only; no persistence claim is made.
affected_facts: Visible #result text after the load action = "Smoke item — ready"
test_points.core_expected: After clicking Load item, the visible #result text is exactly Smoke item — ready.
must_not_change: No fixture business data is mutated by this read-only lookup.
Do not claim the result persists after refresh or a later session.
test_points.scope_note: The critical UI Case is an evidence variant of this same visible-result point: it additionally checks the Item lookup heading and requires a key screenshot plus non-empty video. Those are Case/evidence requirements, not separate business behavior or persistence expectations.

granularity_review.rationale: The API response and UI visible result are distinct observable mechanisms and are split into atomic test points. The critical UI video/heading requirement is evidence and an additional assertion for the same UI event, not a separate business outcome.

test_points_self_review.review_boundary: This self-review checks completeness and consistency against the fixture/test-baseline model only; it does not establish user confirmation or real-business correctness.
